newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dhana Siam says to submit banking plan.
newsitem.headline: Dhana Siam says to submit banking plan.

text.p: Thai broker Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc is preparing to lead a group of Thai finance firms to apply for a commercial banking licence, the firm said on Fridaty.

"Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc notified that its board of directors resolved on June 26 to approve the policy to have DS lead a merger, aiming to seek approval from the authorities to set up a new commercial bank," the firm said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

The firm said it would lead a consortium but accept only quality assets into any merging group. An internal committee has been formed to study and prepare for the move for which shareholder approval will be sorted from at a later date, the statement said.

The central bank on Friday suspended the operation of 16 financially distressed finance and securities firms and appointed Dhana Siam and four other larger finance firms to lead consolidation in the sector.
The bank said it would award between two and five new banking licences to consolidating groups.

The Thai finance and securities sector is struggling to cope with declining revenues, high funding costs and a deterioratioon in asset quality as Thailand goes through its worst economic downturn for more than a decade.
